basic_details.post_name: Sr. Dy. Traffic Manager, Sr. Dy. Chief Accounts Officer
basic_details.short_information: Mormugao Port Authority has officially released a notification for the recruitment of 2 Sr. Dy. Traffic Manager, Sr. Dy. Chief Accounts Officer Posts. This recruitment drive offers a great opportunity for candidates looking for PSU jobs. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website.

application_fee.all_fee: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 42 years for both posts. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government of India guidelines for SC/ST, OBC, and Others.

qualification.details: SR. DY. TRAFFIC MANAGER: A degree from a recognized University with 12 years of experience in Shipping/ Cargo Operations/ Railway Transportation in an executive cadre in an Industrial/ Commercial/ Govt. Undertaking. SR. DY. CHIEF ACCOUNTS OFFICER: Member of the Institute of Chartered Accountant of India or the Institute of Cost and Works Accountants of India, with 12 years of experience in an executive cadre in the field of Finance, Accounting in an Industrial/ Commercial/ Govt. Undertaking.

salary_details.details: Basic Pay, DA based on IDA pattern and Cafeteria allowances @ 35% of Basic Pay. Gratuity, HRA or quarters, Medical benefits, leave encashment, etc. are also admissible as per Rules of Mormugao Port Authority, Goa / Government of India guidelines.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Mormugao Port Authority Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 19-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Mormugao Port Authority to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Mormugao Port Authority Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 19-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Mormugao Port Authority to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Mormugao Port Authority Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Mormugao Port Authority Recruitment 2026 is 19 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the SR. DY. TRAFFIC MANAGER post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the SR. DY. TRAFFIC MANAGER post in the Mormugao Port Authority Recruitment 2026.

faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the SR. DY. TRAFFIC MANAGER post is a degree from a recognized University with 12 years of relevant experience.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the SR. DY. CHIEF ACCOUNTS OFFICER post is 42 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms.

faq.answer: The salary offered for these posts ranges from Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 2,20,000 per month, along with other allowances and benefits.

faq.answer: The selection process for Mormugao Port Authority Recruitment 2026 includes a written examination followed by an interview.
